notes: No C++ AC in the corpus. orig.cpp models arrangements as perfect matchings between cards and seats (official editorial, subtask 2) and finds the fixed cards from the SCCs of the alternating graph (Tassa), with a prefix chain so unreported cards add O(1) arcs. It matches a brute force over all permutations on small gen.py cases and a per-edge Kuhn matching check for N <= 60.
